tagline: Independent production house in Vietnam offering video production, editing, and remote post-production services for clients worldwide.
hero_description:
CR3W is an independent production house based in Vietnam, working across film, commercials, music videos, and branded content.

From production to post-production, we collaborate with creators and clients worldwide, both on-site and remotely.

Based in Vietnam. Working worldwide, on-site and remotely.
projects_description: Explore our selected film, commercial, music video, and branded content projects, including production details, credits, and festival recognition.
events_description: Official selections and awards from festivals, screenings, and project markets.
members_description: Each member takes on different roles depending on the project.
contact_description: Email us about a short film, commercial, or music video you are developing.
footer_text: CREW is the film collective of Hoa Sen University, active since 2022.

works.title: New Year’s Eve on the Edge of the City

works.title: Lucky Charm

works.synopsis: A cheerful girl sings and vibes in a colourful, messy bathroom—a reflection of her inner world as she falls in love.

works.title: Vạch
works.alt: A scene from Vạch, showing a close-up of feet and shoes
works.synopsis: A model high school student tries to take a pregnancy test at school. This was director Đặng Thùy Trang’s debut short film.

Official Selection, Xinê Xem Short 2024 (Xinê House)

works.title: Mannequin
works.alt: A scene from Mannequin, showing a girl doing homework beside a mannequin

works.synopsis: A fashion design student struggles to finish her assignment while being repeatedly disturbed by a mysterious force from an unused room in her boarding house.
awards: Official Selection, Tiệc phim ngắn Lagi 2024 (Trigger Film Academy)
credits: Producer, Director: Nguyễn Lê Uyển Thư

works.title: Bad Date
works.alt: A scene from Bad Date, featuring red lighting and a monster’s silhouette
works.synopsis: Inside a BDSM room at a love hotel, a boyfriend’s body lies on the bed beside a roaring monster. His frightened girlfriend hides behind a love seat.
awards: Official Selection, End of Semester Screening 2022 (Hoa Sen, CGV Cinema)
Official Selection, Tiệc phim ngắn Lagi 2024 (Trigger Film Academy)
Official Selection, Xinê Xem Short 2024 (Xinê House)

works.title: One-shot “A Random Story”
works.alt: A scene from the one-shot A Random Story, featuring a couple kissing in a café
works.synopsis: A couple discusses robbing the café they are sitting in. This is a remake of a scene from Quentin Tarantino’s Pulp Fiction.

works.title: One-shot “In Another Universe”
works.alt: A scene from the one-shot In Another Universe, featuring a girl beside a fish tank
works.synopsis: In a Spider-Man universe somewhere in Vietnam, Quyên—chosen to become that universe’s spider-girl—has a direct conversation with her police-officer father about her pent-up frustrations. This is a remake of a scene from Sony Pictures’ Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse.
